sections.description:
Create alt texts and image titles directly in WordPress with AI.

Create suitable alt texts and image titles directly in your WordPress media library. neoAlt recognizes the image content, takes the context of the page into account, and delivers clear suggestions for better accessibility and image SEO.

With filters, search, and bulk processing, you can also enhance large image collections quickly. You can review, edit, and only then save each suggestion.

🏝️ Sandbox for neo Alt

Try neo Alt directly in the browser without having to install it.

→ Start Sandbox

🚀️ Main Features of neo Alt

  • ✅ Automatically create SEO-friendly alt texts for WordPress images using AI 🎉
  • ✅ Find and fill missing alternative texts across the entire WordPress media library
  • ✅ Edit image titles and alt text individually, together, or via bulk generation
  • ✅ Analyze visible image content for precise and understandable image descriptions
  • ✅ Consider page context and existing media titles for appropriate alt texts
  • ✅ Improve accessibility and image SEO with meaningful image metadata
  • ✅ Review AI suggestions before saving, adjust manually or discard
  • ✅ Save individual changes or accept all reviewed suggestions at once
  • ✅ Filter only empty alt texts and quickly close gaps in the media library
  • ✅ Find images by title and filename using AND, OR, and wildcard search
  • ✅ Sort media by upload date, modified date, title, or URL
  • ✅ Exclude selected images from bulk processing
  • ✅ Character counter for alt texts with a recommendation of 80 to 125 characters
  • ✅ Use neoAI for free image text generations
  • ✅ Configure your own AI connection with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Mistral, WordPress AI, or self-hosted models
  • ➡️ Automatically create missing alt texts and image titles in the media library

Help and Support

  • WordPress Forum: https://wp.org/support/plugin/neo-alt
  • neo Alt Free Support: https://neo-wp.com/contact/#free
  • neo Alt Pro Support: https://neo-wp.com/contact/#pro

Get Pro features

Find out what the Pro version of neo Alt has to offer to unlock the full potential of your media. ➔ What the Pro version can do

Installation & Activation

Installation via the WordPress Plugin Directory

  • Open the WordPress dashboard > Plugins > Add New
  • Search for “neo Alt” and click “Install Now”.
  • After installation click “Activate”.

Installation from neo Alt from the official neoWP website

  • Download the Alt-Text Generator plugin from the official website neo-wp.com.
  • Open the WordPress dashboard > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin > Activate Plugin

Manual installation of neo Alt via FTP

  • Download the Alt-Text Generator plugin from the official website neo-wp.com.
  • Unzip the ZIP file and upload the neo-alt folder via FTP to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  • Go to the WordPress dashboard > Plugins > In the list click “neo Alt” and click “Activate”.

After activating the Alt-Text Generator plugin

  • Click “neoWP” in the sidebar of the WordPress dashboard to review and adjust the default options.
  • Adjust the “neo Alt” settings to your individual requirements.

Compatibility and Requirements

Minimum system requirements for the Alt-Text Generator plugin

  • WordPress version 6.2 to 7.0
  • PHP version 8.0 or higher
  • MySQL version 8.0 or higher
  • Optimized for servers running Linux (not Windows)
  • Server memory limit: min. 128 MB

Compatible plugins and tools for neo Alt

The plugin neo Alt was tested with: Bricks, Elementor, Divi, Beaver, Oxygen, Breakdance, Gutenberg, WP Fastest Cache, LiteSpeed Cache, WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, WP-Optimize, Autoptimize, Breeze, Cache Enabler

Legal notice about the Alt-Text Generator plugin

The plugin neo Alt is provided free of charge under the “GPLv2 or later” license and without warranty. Use is at your own risk; liability for damages is excluded. Users outside Germany are responsible for complying with local regulations. This plugin may contact external services for licensing via Freemius (EULA, license terms, opt-in information, privacy policy), updates, support and optional AI features. When using neoAI the selected image, the prompt and, where applicable, image title, adjacent titles, previous suggestions and page context are sent via neoAI to OpenAI in the USA or, if using your own API key, directly to the chosen provider. Personal or confidential data must not be transmitted. The connection is only established when an administrator tests it, retrieves a quota or triggers a generation. The terms and privacy notices of the service used apply: neoAI (terms, privacy), OpenAI (connection to api.openai.com, terms, privacy), Anthropic (connection to api.anthropic.com, terms, privacy), Google Gemini (connection to generativelanguage.googleapis.com, terms, privacy), xAI (connection to api.x.ai, terms, privacy) and Mistral (connection to api.mistral.ai, terms, privacy). For custom and WordPress integrations the respective configuration determines the recipient.
Details about data, recipients, storage and transfers to third countries can be found in the full privacy policy.
sections.faq:
Features of neo Alt

Which features are included in the plugin?

The main features of the Alt Text Generator plugin are:

  • ✅ Fill missing alt texts in the WordPress media library with AI 🎉
  • ✅ Generate image titles and alt texts individually or together
  • ✅ Edit multiple images in one go using bulk processing
  • ✅ Consider image content, existing image titles, and the context of the page where they are used
  • ✅ Review generated suggestions before saving
  • ✅ Edit AI texts directly, save individually or apply them all at once
  • ✅ Show only images without alt text and complete them selectively
  • ✅ Find and sort media by title, filename, upload date, modification date, or URL
  • ✅ Exclude individual images from bulk generation
  • ✅ Keep recommended alt text length in view with a character counter
  • ✅ Discard changes or restore saved values
  • ✅ Use free monthly neoAI quota directly

Neo Universe

What is the neoUniverse?

The neoUniverse is more than just a collection of plugins. It is your complete toolbox for all media challenges in WordPress. It currently includes ten specialized plugins: neoLibrary, neoRename, neoReplace, neoDuplicate, neoOptimize, neoLazy, neoDraw, neoAnimate and neoMotion. They work seamlessly together, are perfectly aligned, and cover all areas of media management, SEO and performance. Whether renaming images, replacing files, optimizing for SEO, enabling lazy load, or drawing and animating content. The neoUniverse makes your media workflow noticeably simpler and more efficient. And the best part: the neoUniverse keeps growing. New tools and features make your WordPress everyday life even better.

Download with Safari

Why is only a folder shown when downloading?

If you use Safari, your Mac might automatically unzip the ZIP file. Instead of the ZIP file you then only get the unzipped folder. You cannot upload this folder directly to WordPress.

Solution: Open Safari Preferences and disable the option ”Open safe files after downloading”. After that the ZIP file will remain as you need it.

You can find exact details in the video titled ”How to disable Safari auto extract for ZIP files when downloading WordPress plugins” on YouTube.

More questions

I have more questions. Can you help me?

Sure! You can always ask us your questions via our Support page. We will reply shortly.
